pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, irregular polygonal dark regions with sharp, jagged edge gradients. Patches on the mid-flank exhibit higher spatial area compared to smaller, more condensed patches observed on the lower neck and upper forelimb.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light cream-colored pathways with relatively uniform pixel thickness. Junction nodes primarily consist of 3-way and 4-way intersections forming a cohesive topological graph across the visible lateral surface.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Dark, low-amplitude serrated silhouette visible along the dorsal ridge of the neck and shoulder, presenting high-frequency pixel fluctuations against the out-of-focus background.
